sun.java2d.pipe.hw

接口 AccelSurface

  • 所有超级接口:
    BufferedContextProvider, Surface
    所有已知实现类:
    D3DSurfaceData, D3DSurfaceData.D3DWindowSurfaceData, OGLSurfaceData, WGLSurfaceData, WGLSurfaceData.WGLOffScreenSurfaceData, WGLSurfaceData.WGLVSyncOffScreenSurfaceData, WGLSurfaceData.WGLWindowSurfaceData

    public interface AccelSurface
extends BufferedContextProvider, Surface
    Abstraction for a hardware accelerated surface.

    • 字段概要

      限定符和类型 字段和说明
      static int FLIP_BACKBUFFER
      A back-buffer surface (SwapChain surface for Direct3D, backbuffer for OpenGL)
      static int RT_PLAIN
      Render-To Plain surface (pbuffer for OpenGL, Render Target surface for Direct3D)
      static int RT_TEXTURE
      Render-To Texture surface (fbobject for OpenGL, texture with render-to attribute for Direct3D)
      static int TEXTURE
      Texture surface
      static int UNDEFINED
      Undefined
      static int WINDOW
      Window (or window substitute) surface

    • 方法详细资料

      • getType

        int getType()
        Returns int representing surface's type as defined by constants in this interface.
        返回:
        an integer representing this surface's type
        另请参阅:
        UNDEFINED, WINDOW, RT_PLAIN, TEXTURE, FLIP_BACKBUFFER, RT_TEXTURE

      • getNativeOps

        long getNativeOps()
        Returns a pointer to the native surface data associated with this surface. Note: this pointer is only valid on the rendering thread.
        返回:
        pointer to the native surface's data

      • getNativeResource

        long getNativeResource(int resType)
        Returns a pointer to the real native resource of the specified type associated with this AccelSurface. Note: this pointer is only valid on the rendering thread.
        参数:
        resType - the type of the requested resource
        返回:
        a long containing a pointer to the native resource of the specified type or 0L if such resource doesn't exist for this surface

      • markDirty

        void markDirty()
        Marks this surface dirty.

      • isValid

        boolean isValid()
        Returns whether the pipeline considers this surface valid. A surface may become invalid if it is disposed of, or resized.
        返回:
        true if valid, false otherwise

      • isSurfaceLost

        boolean isSurfaceLost()
        Returns whether this surface is lost. The return value is only valid on the render thread, meaning that even if this method returns true it could be lost in the next moment unless it is called on the rendering thread.
        返回:
        true if the surface is known to be lost, false otherwise

      • getBounds

        Rectangle getBounds()
        Returns the requested bounds of the destination surface. The real bounds of the native accelerated surface may differ. Use getNativeBounds() to get the bounds of the native surface.
        返回:
        Rectangle representing java surface's bounds

      • getNativeBounds

        Rectangle getNativeBounds()
        Returns real bounds of the native surface, which may differ from those returned by getBounds().
        返回:
        Rectangle representing native surface's bounds
